title: The Nvidia H200 China deal survived the Trump-Xi summit–just not in the way anyone expected
summary: This article reports on the failed Nvidia H200 chip export deal to China, where despite President Trump bringing Jensen Huang to Beijing during a Trump-Xi summit, no actual H200 chips have shipped since December 2025. US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer confirmed ongoing semiconductor export controls remain in effect.
problem_solved: Explains why US chip exports to China remain blocked despite diplomatic negotiations between Trump and Xi.
why_valuable: Provides real-time insight into the ongoing US-China tech trade tensions and their direct impact on the global AI semiconductor market.
